zh: 新公式从空白编辑区开始，完成后才插入；取消、插入和更新按钮移到画布上方。修复文档公式列表不全、冷启动侧栏保存超时、保存后重开失败和画布恢复空白，减少重复捕获与窗口切换。补齐卷积星号、dots、displaystyle 和 cases 行距，保留多行与中文标注。支持 ⌘A 替换整条公式。插入结果未确认时可保留草稿并关闭，避免卡住或重复插入。
en: Start new equations on a blank canvas and insert only when ready. Cancel, Insert and Update now sit above the canvas. Fix incomplete document lists, cold-start sidebar saves, reopening and hidden-canvas rendering; reduce repeated captures and window switching. Add convolution asterisks, dots, displaystyle and cases row spacing, preserve multiline and Chinese annotations, and support Command-A replacement. Unconfirmed insertions keep the draft and allow closing without repeated submission.
